action: Show up fully for the second week of NEMT shifts at Millfield Medical Transport. Twenty hours part-time, but I treat every shift as an audition for the full-time slot. I learn the routes that other drivers complain about. I am on time, every run, no missed pickups. I introduce myself by name to the dispatchers and the nursing staff at Millfield General on pickup. I am not the new guy who is quiet and hoping to be renewed. I am the new guy who is already fluent.
